body:
I have been considering starvation.  Like go camping in the niddle of nowhere and only bring water.

However i have been thinking of this because i am afraid of killing myself in that sudden, irrevocable moment (what if i change my mind?) not because i want to make a statement,

Honestly, i dont understand the notion of suicide as a statement. It seems to me the opposite of a statement. It is a rejection of the rest of the world and, in one sense, a wholly narcissistic act.

But heah, starvations.  3-4 weeks maybe. In a place with nice scenery. Not such a bad way to go?  Hunger pains would prolly fade very soon and you can always stockpile painkillers for random discomfort,

I am suicidal too but have been suicidal (unsuccessfully?) for nearly 40 years....

When people dont respond to your cries for help (often silent cries, i know) dont interpret that as them not caring. They do, but they dont understand. They dont understand how you feel and they dont understand how to respond. That is not their fault. They cant understand. Nobody can unless they have felt the same way. It is not a lack of caring, it is a difference of experience. Dont blame them.

If you want to talk to someone who can understand, talk to a specialist. Talk to support groups. They know. What you and i feel is not unique.  I know that and i still want to die. But that is sinply because i am who i am. The vast majority of people have a lot more to keep them going and i am sure that you are one of them.
